description: List the wilayas (provinces) of Algeria: 69 since loi n° 26-06 of 4 April 2026 (Journal officiel n° 25): the 58 numbered ones, then the 11 created by that law (Aflou, Barika, El Kantara, Bir El Ater, El Aricha, Ksar Chellala, Aïn Ouessara, Messaad, Ksar El Boukhari, Bou Saada, El Abiodh Sidi Cheikh), numbered 59 to 69 by décret présidentiel n° 26-206 of 25 May 2026 (Journal officiel n° 40), which come with their mother wilaya, their communes and in_place_by (their mother wilaya runs them until 31 December 2026 at the latest). For each wilaya in the dataset, with their two-digit code, their names in the three languages, capital, region and population, the address and phone of the local CNRC (trade register) office and the address of the local CASNOS (social security of the self-employed) office. Codes, names and capitals come from décret 84-79 (01 to 48), décret présidentiel 21-117 (49 to 58) and décret présidentiel 26-206 (59 to 69), cited in meta.sources; population, region, office details and websites do not come from the Journal officiel (meta.fields_not_from_jo). Use it to turn a wilaya code into a name or the reverse, or to find the local offices for a company registration or a CASNOS affiliation. For Tunisia (country TN) it lists the 24 governorates instead: code, ISO 3166-2 code, national statistics (INS) code, names in the three languages, chief town and the official source, and the answer names every page it was read on. For Morocco (country MA) it lists the 12 regions of the 2015 division the same way: code, ISO 3166-2 code, names in the three languages, chief town and the official source. The list is short and takes no filter. Tunisia and Morocco need an API key.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

name: list_wilayas
title: List wilayas and governorates
